svg.text: Broker Abstraction Layer — Adapter Pattern for Multi-Broker Support
STRATEGY PROCESSES — Survivor · Wave Extractor · Expiry Trade · Early Exit · Covered Calls (UNCHANGED — no broker-specific code)
common_lib.py — place_order(), get_positions(), retry_with_backoff(), dry-run safety gate (calls the interface below, never a broker SDK)
raises: AuthError · OrderRejected · RateLimited · InstrumentNotFound · BrokerUnavailable
test double — no live credentials required
Contract test suite runs against every
Zerodha · Fyers · Upstox — redirect + token exchange
Shoonya · Flattrade · Alice Blue — user/pass + TOTP/2FA
Dhan — API key + access token, no redirect
keyed by underlying + expiry + strike + type
reads [broker] config → returns active adapter(s); per-process assignment in multi-broker mode
canonical instrument → broker-native identifier, per active broker
BrokerFactory instantiates the adapter(s) below, per config
LEGEND — ROLLOUT PHASES (per Broker Abstraction PRD §8)
Existing — refactor Kite code into ZerodhaAdapter, zero behavior change
Build MockAdapter + contract test suite (release gate for every adapter after)
Dhan — simplest auth (static API key), first real second broker
Shoonya + Flattrade together — shared NorenApi base, most code reuse
Fyers + Upstox — OAuth-redirect family, reuse OAuthRedirectAuth
Multi-broker concurrent mode — broker-tagging across Trade Journal / Position Guard
